summary: Navient Solutions, LLC, as administrator for SLM Student Loan Trust 2004-5, furnished a 8-K reporting that on October 14, 2026 it delivered a preliminary remarketing memorandum to the remarketing agent for distribution to qualified institutional buyers to remarket the Trust's Class A-6 Reset Rate Notes. Exhibit 99.1 provides pool statistics on the FFELP student loan collateral as of August 31, 2026. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, or advisor was disclosed. Routine ABS remarketing disclosure; watch reset coupon and reinvestment terms for noteholders.
